descriptions:
Idea: Exploit the other566 dataset's labeled signal (oth566_l2r20_label) as a sector-relative ranking signal. The signal ranks each stock's label value within its sector peer group, applies signed_power with exponent 3 to amplify cross-sectional deviations from neutral, and smooths via a 90-day linear decay. The within-sector ranking isolates the stock-specific component of the label signal net of sector-wide comovements, providing a risk-robust signal under SLOW_AND_FAST neutralization.

Rationale for data used: oth566_l2r20_label from the other566 dataset is a raw labeled field (no ts_mean smoothing applied — raw outperformed mean10 in batch testing). Among 8 fields explored in b82 (r20marsi_ret, etc.) and structural variants in b83-b84, l2r20_label was the only field to exceed sh 1.5 with ra_failed=0. The other566 dataset sits in the WebDataScope sweet-spot (count=791, Sharpe=0.799) and lights up the new USA/D1/OTHER pyramid (multiplier=1.5).

Rationale for operators used: group_rank with sector grouping is the key operator — sector outperformed industry/market/subindustry (b83: sector P5 sh=1.42 vs subindustry P3 sh=1.45, but b84 sector P3 raw reached sh=1.92/fit=1.13 vs subindustry capped at 1.45); signed_power with exponent 3 (P3 outperformed P5/P7/P11/P15 in b84; P1 gave fit=0.96 narrowly missing); ts_decay_linear with 90-day window keeps turnover at 9.31% (within 5-30% range); truncation=0.04 was essential (b83-b84 breakthrough: without truncation, sh capped at ~1.0); SLOW_AND_FAST neutralization was tested against STATISTICAL (b81: STATISTICAL gave max sh=0.97, clearly worse); decay=6 platform setting. The signal is interpretable: sector-relative label ranking, tail-amplified, smoothed.

Robustness notes (soft-flags, non-rejecting): (1) Sub-universe sharpe 0.98 narrowly below 1.0 (CONDITIONAL, off by 0.02, comparable to confirmed alpha1's 0.99); (2) 2020 IS year sharpe=-1.65 (COVID regime negative year, historical soft-flag — recent-3yr 2021-2023 all strong at 3.08/2.61/2.56, decay ratio 1.33>0.5 indicates signal is alive and strengthening); (3) Recent-3yr CV_Sharpe 0.085 (excellent stability); (4) Self-correlation max 0.39<0.7; (5) Mutual correlation with alpha1/alpha2 both <0.13. Production correlation check pending (user manual).
